entries.question: Mujhe OT ke liye admission lena hai
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) offers various paramedical diploma courses. To get admission in the OT Technician course, you can follow these steps:

1.  **Check Eligibility and Admission Information:** Visit the official KGMU website for the Faculty of Paramedical Sciences. Look for the "Admission Information" or "Paramedical Admission" section.
    *   You can find this information here: [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php)

2.  **Look for Admission Notifications:** Keep an eye on the KGMU website, specifically the "Notice Board" or "Marquee" section, for announcements regarding paramedical admissions. These notifications usually contain details about application dates, eligibility criteria, and the admission process.

3.  **Application Process:** Typically, you will need to fill out an application form, which is usually available on the KGMU website during the admission period. Ensure you meet the eligibility criteria for the OT Technician course.

4.  **Entrance Examination/Selection Process:** Admissions to paramedical courses often involve an entrance examination. The notification will specify the details of the selection process.

For the most current and specific information regarding the OT Technician course admission, I recommend visiting the Paramedical Sciences section of the KGMU website directly: [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_about_faculty.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_about_faculty.php)

Please note that admission timelines and procedures can change, so it's always best to refer to the latest information on the official KGMU website.

entries.question: Sir kgmu me patient kase dikhaye
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD (Outpatient Department) mein dikhane ke liye, aapko online registration karwana hoga. 

Aap in tareekon se appointment book kar sakte hain:

1.  **Website:** www.ors.gov.in (mobile internet ke through)
2.  **Phone:** 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333
3.  **SMS:** "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.

Jab aap OPD mein aayein, toh apne appointment ka printed copy ya SMS saath laana na bhoolen. OPD ka samay subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 2:00 baje tak hai.
